title: ruellia caroliniensis var. heteromorpha
intro: Ruellia caroliniensis var. heteromorpha, commonly known as wild petunia, is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, headache, and inflammation. The health benefits of wild petunia include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic agent. The bioactive constituents of Ruellia caroliniensis var. heteromorpha include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as modulating the immune system and reducing oxidative stress.
